name: vspi
description: VSPi client for the VSP agent runtime.

scripts.package:pack: pnpm run build && pnpm run package:stage && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('.tmp/package-artifacts', { recursive: true })" && npm pack .tmp/package-stage --pack-destination .tmp/package-artifacts
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const p of ['dist', '.tmp/package-stage', '.tmp/package-artifacts']) require('fs').rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })"
